official_definition: By sending your 20px, or a core from your Grandwalker Nexus to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Soul Bursts.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [War Catalyze] or [War Catalyze: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [War Catalyze]", "give [War Catalyze]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
